newsitem.title: CHINA: Alcatel sees $130 mln 1996 China turnover.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel sees $130 mln 1996 China turnover.

text.p: The Sino-French joint venture Shanghai Bell-Alcatel expects turnover of $130 million in 1996, making it a major supplier of mobile telecommunications products in China, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
The company was set up in early 1994 to transfer Alcatel's GSM technology to China, it said.
The venture has provided GSM networks for eight provinces and municipalities and provides services for 700,000 mobile telephone users, the report said.
The French firm plans to increase its share of China's GSM market to 25 percent in two years, it said but gave no comparative figures. The report gave no more details.
